'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Fezz the DOG DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Fezz the DOG]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge]]
* '''Username:''' Punkbear
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
